name: Carol the Witch
original_name: キャロル・ザ・ウィッチ
source:
A taciturn witch who seldom graces the world with a smile.
Carol is an ice queen adorned with piercing eyes and a slender silhouette. Her collaboration with a human, Tsunuga, is an unconventional arrangement within the witching community. Furthermore, Tsunuga holds the honor of being her exclusive intimate partner during her recuperative periods.

Her Brutal Edge is a  [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zweih%C3%A4nder]zweihänder[/url] that towers over her.
